svg.title: PangoLock: zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS (exploded isometric view)
svg.desc: Exploded isometric drawing of the PangoLock key flow. A packet descends through layers: password, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 210,000 iterations, master key checked by a zero-knowledge verifier, HKDF-SHA256 per-item key, AES-256-GCM, and an atomic write of <uuid>.plock into the vault. After decrypt-and-compare passes, the original is removed and the layers collapse into the vault, whose dial spins to lock. A side bracket traces the key chain: PBKDF2 to master key, HKDF to item key. Notes list 87 XCTest tests, CI on macOS, crash-window tests, verify-before-delete, a written threat model, recovery key, portable lockers and encrypted sharing.
svg.text: Zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS · Swift · SwiftUI · macOS 13+

g.text: one key per item, from the master key
